_comment: Consortium Core shop catalogue, Season 1 (docs/SHOP_CATALOGUE.md section 3, pack 0.7.0). 24 entries, every price a PLACEHOLDER in credits sized as days of the median design income of docs/PRICE_TABLE.md 6 (rung bands A to E) until the beta-week ledger read. Never sell an item the price table buys (the mod hides and refuses it). Command entries address the buyer by {player} (FTB Chunks refuses a UUID) and carry {tx} so the engine command is idempotent (consortium_shop.js, txs.<tx>); every refusal happens before the debit in the BalanceChangeEvent pre-check of consortium_shop.js because a failed effect is never refunded. Gates: stage = the buyer's team stage (consortium:phase_3 locks the loaders, consortium:vacancy_<charter> is a sale stage the engine opens and closes), phase = the board phase from which the entry sells. The daily limit resets at 00:00 UTC on Consortium Core 0.3.0 and at 06:00 server time from 0.3.1. Replaces starter.json (deleted: the first file in id order wins, so a leftover copy would resurrect the placeholder prices).
